title: Kids Judo Program
content: WRJA offers Kids Judo programmes for children aged 6-12 years. Training takes place on Tuesdays and Thursdays from 17:00-18:00 at our Randburg dojo (123 Judo Street). Cost is R200 per month. All skill levels welcome from beginners to advanced. Kids learn discipline, respect, confidence, and self-defense through fun judo activities.

title: Adult Judo Program
content: WRJA offers Adult Judo programmes for ages 13 and above. Training takes place on Mondays and Wednesdays from 19:00-20:30 at our Randburg dojo (123 Judo Street). Cost is R300 per month. Classes focus on technique, sparring, competition preparation, and physical fitness. Beginners are welcome.

title: Women's Judo Program
content: WRJA offers Women's Judo programmes on Fridays from 18:00-19:30 at our Randburg dojo (123 Judo Street). Cost is R250 per month. This is a supportive environment for women of all skill levels to learn judo, self-defense, and fitness in a comfortable setting.

title: Competition Team
content: WRJA has a dedicated competition team for advanced students who wish to compete at provincial, national, and international levels. Training sessions are held on Saturdays from 09:00-11:00 at our Randburg dojo. Team members participate in tournaments throughout South Africa.

title: Beginners Judo Course
content: WRJA offers a 6-week Beginners Judo Course for newcomers with no experience. The course covers basic techniques, falls, throws, and pins. Cost is R500 for the full 6-week course. Classes are held on Saturdays from 11:00-12:00. All equipment is provided.
